entitycounter.hud.title: Entity Counter
entitycounter.config.title: Entity Counter Settings
entitycounter.config.highlight.desc: Marks the counted block with a glowing green box.
entitycounter.mode.auto.desc: Sees through glass and picks the first block that contains entities.
entitycounter.mode.looked_at.desc: Exactly the block under your crosshair.
entitycounter.mode.in_front.desc: The block in front of the one you look at.
entitycounter.mode.behind.desc: The block directly behind the one you look at.
entitycounter.config.coordinates.desc: Shows the position of the counted block in the panel.
